channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Sensex, Nifty trade flat; IT index dips 1.35 pc
item.description: As of 9.30 am, Sensex lost 27 points, or 0.03 per cent, to reach 83,423, and Nifty dipped 2 points, or 0.01 per cent at 25,722.

item.title: India-China rivalry deepens at US panel​
item.description: At a hearing of the U.S.-China Economic and Security Review Commission, experts said India's rivalry with China remains structural despite recent border disengagement. They warned that China's military build-up, regional influence, and supply chain dominance continue to heighten India's concerns.

item.title: Pakistan court extends pre-arrest bail of Imran Khan in multiple cases
item.description: The court also extended the pre-arrest and interim bail of Bushra Bibi in related cases. The charges stem from the May 9 unrest and include allegations of attempted murder and submission of forged receipts.

item.title: Nearly 15,000 teaching posts acant in J&K, govt tells Assembly
item.description: The J&K government informed the Legislative Assembly that 14,943 teaching posts, including 12,977 teachers and 1,946 Masters, are lying vacant across the Union Territory. While the Jammu division accounts for the majority of vacancies, the government said promotional posts are being filled through departmental committees.

item.title: AGI on the horizon, AI a huge opportunity for India's youth: Google DeepMind CEO
item.description: At the India AI Impact Summit 2026, Demis Hassabis, CEO and co-founder of Google DeepMind, said artificial general intelligence (AGI) could emerge within five to eight years. He described the current phase as a "threshold moment" and a potential "golden era" of scientific discovery.

item.title: Sidharth Malhotra mourns father Sunil Malhotra death, shares rare photos; actor Pravina Deshpande dies of cancer
item.description: Bollywood is grieving the loss of two of its loved ones. Actor Sidharth Malhotra's father, Sunil Malhotra, passed away on February 14, and the family is in Delhi following the last rites. Meanwhile, veteran actor Pravina Deshpande succumbed to cancer, and her last rites will be held today.

item.title: Chiranjeevi undergoes shoulder keyhole surgery; assures fans on his recovery
item.description: Megastar Chiranjeevi has clarified that he has undergone a minor shoulder keyhole surgery. He is recovering well and already getting back to his routine.

item.title: K'taka Cong lawmakers on foreign tour amid leadership crisis, reject claims of political motive
item.description: Amid an ongoing leadership tussle in the Karnataka Congress, a group of legislators left for a private foreign tour, triggering political speculation. The MLAs and MLCs, many considered close to Chief Minister Siddaramaiah, departed from Kempegowda airport.

item.title: Mamitha Baiju recalls memorable on-set moments with Vijay, Suriya and Dhanush
item.description: Actress Mamitha Baiju, who is set for back-to-back releases, gushes about her shooting experience with Vijay, Suriya and Dhanush on the sets of Jana Nayagan, Suriya 46 and Kara.

item.title: Allu Arjun "conditions" row: Brand manager apologises, issues clarification about "42 dos and don'ts"
item.description: Kaveri Baruah has officially offered an apology to stylish star Allu Arjun and team and issued clarification that no document containing "42 dos and don'ts" was issued to her by Allu Arjun's team.
